title: Mount Zeil as an alien port of entry to Earth

tellings.quote: Mount Zeal is sort of a port of entry to the earth that friendly ones go there

plain: Mount Zeil, a mountain in Australia, is said to be 'sort of a port of entry to the earth' where 'friendly ones', meaning friendly visitors from elsewhere, come in. A former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan tells Michels this and ties the idea to a man named Pat Price. If it were true, there would be a fixed place on Earth where friendly non-human visitors arrive.
